name: High Score Hyrax
source:
Thanks to a little bit of skill, and whole lot of dumb luck, Saul has found himself in the middle of the biggest online shitstorm of the century.

Well, that's an exaggeration - but it's certainly how he feels about it. After only a month of speedrunning an old game by the name of [b]Bomber Bros. 3[/b], he's already managed to secure a spot near the top of the game's leaderboards thanks to an absurdly lucky run - and has quickly gone from a nobody, to one of the most widely discussed figures in the game's community.  

But as rumors swirl, and the game's top runners chat and gossip amongst themselves wondering if his run was cheated or not, Saul attempts to remain headstrong, and ignore all the noise...

Because Saul has a date - and with quite the handsome deer at that!

And, for once in his life, [b]he's determined not to fuck it up[/b] - no matter how many times he'll have to go back in time to retry.

...wait, did I forget to mention that he has time travel powers?

[From [url=https://chmron.itch.io/high-score-hyrax]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
靠着一点技术和一大堆狗屎运，索尔一头卷进了本世纪最大的网络骂战。

好吧，是有点夸张——可他自己真就是这么觉得的。索尔开始速通一款叫作[b]《炸弹兄弟3》[/b]的老游戏才一个月，就凭一次运气好到离谱的成绩冲上了排行榜前列，几乎转眼之间就从无名小卒变成了玩家圈里最常被议论的人之一。

谣言满天飞，顶尖速通玩家们私下里聊来聊去，都在猜他那次究竟作没作弊。索尔努力不让自己动摇，把那些闲话都当耳旁风…

因为索尔有约会——对方还是头相当英俊的鹿！

这辈子至少这一次，[b]他下定决心，绝他妈不能搞砸[/b]——哪怕要一次又一次回到过去，直到约会成功为止。

…等等，我是不是忘了说，他有穿越时间的超能力？
